population: Euler core all-topic emitter; all selected source logs, not token outflows
rule: count of accepted source logs in (event_time-60 seconds,event_time], including current log, >=10
rule_purpose: descriptive workload rule fixed for engineering smoke testing; no attack detection claim
count_scope: all accepted logs from the selected emitter; duplicate and late deliveries excluded; initial window empty and no pre-day history supplied
ordering: block_number, transaction_index, log_index; same timestamp is resolved by this exact chain order
grouping: 300 original event-time seconds anchored on last emitted notification only
budget_clock: playback decision UTC day; grouping precedes admission
queue_model: virtual single-server FIFO using measured per-event local service durations; no wall-clock pacing
removed_field: missing upstream means null; not inferred as false
finality: validated historical canonical archive assumed; no reorg or live-finality support
decoding: JSON structure and hexadecimal payload/topics only; no ABI names, amounts or monetary semantics
recovery: deterministic JSON snapshot continuation only; no transactional outbox or arbitrary-crash delivery guarantee
claim_scope: one real protocol-day software feasibility pilot, not an independent attack evaluation
